\]

\[
3k \equiv 6 \pmod{9}
\;\Longrightarrow\;
k \equiv 2 \pmod{3}.
\]

Thus we can write

\[
k = 3m + 2 \qquad (m\in\mathbb{Z}).
\]

Plugging this back into \(n = 12k + 7\) yields

\[
n = 12(3m+2)+7 = 36m + 24 + 7 = 36m + 31.
\]

So every solution is of the form \(n = 36m + 31\).
